description: Fetch a Medium author's public profile and one content section. Always returns profile metadata (name, bio, avatar, follower/following counts). The section parameter selects what else to load: home (published stories, default), reposts, activity, lists (the author's bookmark lists), or about (long bio). Profile subpages live under https://medium.com/@<username>/<section>. Data comes from the page's embedded Apollo state plus DOM cards for scroll-loaded entries. No login required.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Medium username without the @ prefix, i.e. the segment after @ in the profile URL https://medium.com/@<username>. A leading @ is tolerated and stripped. Matching is case-insensitive.

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Which profile tab to return. One of: home (author's stories, default) | reposts (stories the author reposted; empty for most users) | activity (recent public activity, e.g. claps) | lists (bookmark lists created by the author) | about (long-form bio; limit is ignored).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return for list-like sections home/reposts/activity/lists (1-100, default 20). List sections lazy-load on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or the stream is exhausted, then returns fewer items with partial=true. Ignored when section=about.
